correctness.rationale: PASS: Geometric automorphism images X=a(y)x+f(y), Y=b(y)x+g(y) preserve maximal ideal and have invertible linear determinant a0*g1-f1*b0. Relations are f²+2xaf=0 and m x b g^(m-1)=0. For odd p,m>=3, f1=0 from y² coefficient, then invertibility makes a unit and 2xaf=0 forces f=0; b0 forced zero iff p does not divide m. In characteristic 2, f²=0 requires f∈(y^ceil(m/2)), and b0 forced zero only for odd m. Special odd-characteristic m=2 has two invertible diagonal/antidiagonal components of dimension 4, matching formula. Dual-number derivations yield 2xu=0 and m y^(m-1)v=0, with the printed tangent dimensions. Strict tangent excess yields nonsmooth group scheme; equality implies smoothness for group schemes over fields. Independently enumerated automorphism images for m=2,3 over F2 and F3, getting F2 counts 24,64 and F3 counts 72,2916, consistent with geometric parameter charts; finite points do not prove scheme smoothness or nonreducedness.
